chapter: Leading the band after Chick Webb, 1939-40
title: "Traffic Jam" with Chick, and Chick buying arrangements
summary: The Shaw tunes were redone for Chick; Webb spent his last dime on arrangements by Henderson, Charlie Dixon and Jimmy Mundy.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Did any of the things that you wrote that, of course, were largely done it

seems for Artie Shaw, like 'Back Bay Shuffle,' 'Traffic Jam' -- done with Chick Webb.?
I know that there are a couple of versions of 'Traffic Jams' on some air checks with Chick and orchestra.
You used different arrangements, or were the same arrangements used --
Same. I just redo them, you know, with Chick. (One little) thing called 'Take It From The Top,' or something like that -- 'Bay Shuffle'.
I think what I did with Artie Shaw, when Artie --
I didn't have anything in mind. We had -- in Chick's band -- Chick would spend his last dime for an arranger.
You know, he would make seventy-five dollars, he'd go to Fletcher Henderson and say I want that arrangement.
If the arrangements cost seventy-five dollars or fifty dollars he would buy it the

arrangement.
Chick had a lot of music, because he bought -- he would arrangments. A lot of bands (readus (inaudible)) wouldn't buy music.
Chick would go out --
When I came in the band, I found out that Chick had practically all the top hits -- Fletcher Henderson's top things, and he had from different --
Charlie Dixon was writing -- he would spend money for arrangements. He would even get --
Jimmy Mundy was a great arranger in those days, you know, writing for Paul Whiteman.
And Don --
Don didn't do anything for us too much, because Don was tied up with Paul Whiteman a lot. And he didn't do anything (inaudible). (Inaudible) his band that I know of.
We got -- I didn't get Don to do anything with Chick until after I took the band over, because I needed some arrangements for Ella. You know, (big (inaudible)) pop things that came in and I wanted Don to do them.
